title: Feature implementation drive — plan 001
epic_title: Deliver an end-to-end feature implementation drive

tasks.title: Persist and reconcile feature-drive state
tasks.goal: A feature drive durably reconstructs its lifecycle and executes each planned external effect at most once across crashes and duplicate touches.
tasks.current: No feature-scoped aggregate, ownership lineage, or resumable effect protocol exists above the one-sweep executor.
tasks.desired: A closed, versioned aggregate validates signed transition lineage, persists intent before effects, reconciles idempotently, and resumes every non-terminal state from durable storage without duplicate effects.
scope: Define the aggregate states, owner epoch, waits, evidence references, and closed transition vocabulary.
Implement CAS persistence, signed transition validation, effect intent/observation, and duplicate-touch convergence.
Supply hermetic restart and malformed-lineage fixtures plus a consumer-owned storage conformance suite.
out_of_scope: Routing tasks, operating proposals, constructing candidates, and executing e2e; later tasks consume this lifecycle substrate.
acceptance: Restart injection before and after every CAS/effect boundary resumes to the same next action with no duplicate durable effect.
Missing, malformed, conflicting, stale-epoch, and unknown aggregate observations fail closed with no external write.
Two concurrent reconcilers converge through CAS to one transition and record the loser as a no-op.

tasks.title: Kick off one exclusively routed feature
tasks.goal: An eligible frozen feature starts only after a human selects local or remote ownership and then exposes exactly its ready tasks to that owner on one remote feature branch.
tasks.current: `implement-now` sweeps globally routed ready tasks; task claims cannot reserve future tasks or a feature integration base to one execution domain.
tasks.desired: Kickoff validates the frozen contract, atomically records one authenticated owner and feature branch, derives owner-scoped frontier routing, and invokes the unchanged feature-blind executor with ordinary task inputs; invalid or conflicting starts remain inert with an exact remedy.
scope: Resolve a projected frozen feature and establish its create-only remote integration branch.
Atomically assign local-machine or remote-domain ownership and fence all routing with the current epoch.
Project only the feature's ready frontier and pass task charter, base, routing, epoch, and policy to the executor.
Preserve generic issue execution and cross-machine task claims unchanged.
out_of_scope: Ownership handoff/cancellation and proposal landing progression; T3 and T4 own those transitions.
acceptance: Invalid or unassigned features produce zero task attempts and report the failed precondition; 100 concurrent conflicting kickoffs produce one owner.
Local and remote fixtures route every exposed task only to the recorded domain and target every proposal at the feature branch.
Concurrent unrelated feature and generic issues produce zero cross-feature pickup while generic execution remains unchanged.
Executor interface inspection and conformance prove no feature lifecycle state or merge authority entered the worker core.

tasks.title: Transfer, stop, and resume ownership safely
tasks.goal: A human can hand off, cancel, resume, or abandon a feature without overlapping owners or losing durable work.
tasks.current: There is no feature owner to quiesce or transfer; stale local and remote execution can only race through task claims.
tasks.desired: Ownership-changing requests de-route future work, durably quiesce active attempts, and only then change epochs; cancellation and abandonment preserve artifacts, resume stays inert until reassignment, and failed quiescence retains the old owner with an actionable blocker.
scope: Implement explicit handoff with checkpoint/finish proof and stale-epoch fencing.
Implement cancel-pending, cancelled, explicit resume, and terminal abandonment transitions.
Separate owner/routing release from positively authorized retention cleanup.
out_of_scope: Delivery-triggered cleanup, which T7 performs only after mainline proof.
acceptance: One hundred handoff and cancel/dispatch race repetitions produce zero owner overlap, foreign attempts, or lost checkpoints.
Failed quiescence retains the old owner/epoch and names the blocking attempt; elapsed time never grants takeover.
Cancel preserves every branch, commit, proposal, task, and evidence; resume routes nothing until new assignment and abandonment remains inert.

tasks.title: Advance the DAG only after reviewed landing
tasks.goal: Every implementation increment remains separately human-reviewable, and its dependents unlock only after the reviewed revision is proven on the feature branch.
tasks.current: The executor opens task proposals but leaves landing, tracker completion, feedback repair, and repeated frontier sweeps to an external driver.
tasks.desired: Open and changes-requested proposals keep tasks incomplete; feedback inside the charter repairs the same proposal, feedback outside it creates one linked task, and every supported landing strategy advances exactly the valid dependents.
scope: Observe revision-bound human review and route in-charter feedback to the current owner on the same proposal.
Create idempotent dependency-linked work for out-of-charter feedback without widening the original charter.
Verify reviewed head, base, landed revision, checks, and feature-branch ancestry before recording completion.
Recompute and route the next ready frontier after verified landing.
out_of_scope: Automatic approval or merge of any proposal; human authority remains unchanged.
acceptance: Open, changes-requested, and approved-but-unmerged proposals keep their tasks and dependents incomplete.
In-charter feedback updates one proposal; out-of-charter feedback creates exactly one linked blocked work item.
Merge, squash, and rebase fixtures advance valid dependents; wrong-base, stale-head, absent-revision, and lying-badge fixtures advance none.
Process exit throughout review waits preserves owner, proposal, and frontier with zero live worker/model process.

tasks.title: Publish an immutable candidate merge
tasks.goal: A fully landed feature produces one immutable, reproducible candidate for the exact feature and current-main heads without moving either source branch.
tasks.current: No canonical candidate combines a feature branch with concurrent mainline state for terminal verification.
tasks.desired: The drive blocks while any feature task is incomplete, deterministically constructs and create-only publishes `C = merge(F,M)`, records its complete identity, creates traceable conflict repair instead of evidence on conflict, and invalidates candidates when either input changes.
scope: Gate candidate construction on every implementation and repair task being verified landed.
Build deterministic candidate commits/trees and immutable content-addressed refs from exact inputs.
Detect input movement and merge conflicts before any terminal evidence can authorize delivery.
out_of_scope: Running or judging scenarios on the candidate; T6 owns terminal evidence.
acceptance: Any incomplete task blocks candidate creation, while a fully landed DAG permits it exactly once per input identity.
Identical inputs reproduce one commit, tree, and publication reference while leaving both source branches byte-identical; either-head movement creates a distinct identity.
Conflicts publish no candidate or green evidence and create one evidence-bearing repair item.

tasks.title: Verify candidates and integrate evidence-linked repairs
tasks.goal: Final eligibility exists only when every required scenario has accepted identity-bound evidence on the current candidate, with failures repaired through new reviewed feature work and a full rerun.
tasks.current: E2e authoring artifacts exist, but no feature-drive adapter runs their routes, binds results to a candidate, or turns red integration evidence into repair work.
tasks.desired: Specialized runners win when declared; otherwise execution stays in the owner domain; manual results require human candidate-bound attestation; all non-accepted outcomes block with exact diagnostics; failures create one traceable repair and its landing forces a new candidate and complete suite.
scope: Consume the existing reviewed e2e design/plan without changing its authoring contract.
Route automatic, specialized, and manual-human scenarios and persist immutable candidate evidence with actor/runner identity.
Evaluate the closed outcome matrix, invalidate stale/conflicting evidence, and create idempotent evidence-linked repair work.
Return landed repairs through candidate reconstruction and every required scenario.
out_of_scope: Authoring scenarios or merging repair proposals; existing e2e stages and human authority remain intact.
acceptance: Wrong-candidate, missing-identity, machine-authored manual, failed, skipped, unavailable, inconclusive, pending, conflicting, and partial-suite fixtures all block eligibility.
Specialized routes record their runner; owner-default routes execute locally or remotely according to ownership; valid human attestations settle only their named scenario.
A seeded failure creates one candidate/evidence-linked repair task whose reviewed landing invalidates old evidence.
Only a complete accepted rerun on one new current candidate restores final eligibility.

tasks.title: Propose and prove final delivery
tasks.goal: Current accepted candidate evidence yields one human-merged final proposal, and the drive completes only after proving the accepted tree landed on current main.
tasks.current: No feature-level proposal binds accepted candidate evidence to main, and a merged badge cannot prove the intended feature was delivered.
tasks.desired: The drive opens or updates exactly one final proposal without merge credentials, publishes a verdict bound to exact proposal and target heads only where the medium enforces it, invalidates on review or head movement, and retains ownership until base, tree, and ancestry delivery proof succeeds; release precedes policy-authorized cleanup.
scope: Create the final proposal and candidate verdict from current exact evidence without approving or merging.
Refuse activation when current-base and required-verdict enforcement cannot be proven.
Verify landed base, candidate tree equality, and current-main ancestry before one delivered transition.
Remove routing, release ownership, and then execute only positively authorized terminal cleanup.
out_of_scope: Selecting retention durations or granting the drive merge authority.
acceptance: Exactly one final proposal identifies the feature head, main head, candidate, and evidence; the drive performs zero approval or merge actions.
Feature, main, or final-proposal head movement turns the verdict stale before action, and absent strict current-base enforcement refuses activation.
Merged-badge, wrong-base, wrong-tree, partial, and non-ancestor fixtures remain owned and incomplete with an exact remedy.
Only accepted-base, candidate-tree, and main-ancestry proof delivers once, de-routes, releases ownership, then permits policy-authorized cleanup.

tasks.title: Surface durable actions and owner-scoped wakes
tasks.goal: Humans and unattended drivers can resume a feature from native action surfaces and one cold-readable status without keeping a model or worker alive.
tasks.current: Task-level executor events exist, but no feature lifecycle diagnostic, owner-scoped backstop, or correlated action-required stream reconstructs the complete drive.
tasks.desired: Instruction-free touches wake only the recorded owner domain; waits checkpoint and exit; status reconstructs owner, phase, frontier, pending effect, evidence, primary failure, retained secondary defects, exact remedy, and positive clear condition; lifecycle events and metrics prove idle and inference costs.
scope: Normalize push, manual, and backstop touches and verify all authority independently in reconcile.
Add the minimal status command and native-surface action notifications.
Emit the typed lifecycle/failure stream, correlations, metrics, and critical alerts defined by both designs.
out_of_scope: A unified dashboard or instruction-bearing wake payload.
acceptance: Duplicate touches converge, stale-owner wakes route no foreign work, and each owner-domain backstop scans only its assigned waits.
Every review/manual wait records zero live model sessions and Worker processes until a new touch.
Cold status after restart agrees with durable state and names one blocking condition, evidence, remedy, and positive clear condition for every failure fixture.
Instrumentation attributes zero model tokens to deterministic lifecycle decisions and correlates feature through delivery proof.

tasks.title: Prove local and remote drives end to end
tasks.goal: The complete feature drive ships only after equivalent six-task local and remote journeys prove ownership, review, repair, verification, and delivery invariants without regressing generic execution.
tasks.current: No release fixture exercises the full stage-8-through-stage-10 lifecycle in either ownership mode.
tasks.desired: One deterministic six-task DAG with parallel roots, feedback, seeded e2e failure, repair, final review, and delivery runs in both modes; conformance, race, and security evidence demonstrates one owner, valid DAG progression, human-only merges, current evidence, no pre-final main revision, and verified completion.
scope: Build the shared six-task acceptance fixture and run it through local and remote owner adapters.
Exercise 100-repeat ownership/action races, restart boundaries, malformed authority/evidence, and every closed failure disposition.
Preserve and report the proposal set, journals, evidence chain, ancestry audit, conformance results, and ship-rule metrics.
out_of_scope: Automatic task/final merging, fleet fairness, multi-repository drives, or production rollout beyond the two dogfood cohorts.
acceptance: Both modes complete the same DAG with 100% in-domain attempts, human-reviewed task/final merges, valid frontier transitions, and equivalent terminal state.
Seeded in-charter feedback updates one proposal and seeded e2e failure lands one reviewed repair before a complete accepted rerun.
The full failure, replay, authorization, race, restart, and adapter conformance corpus produces zero unauthorized effect, overlap, stale authorization, or artifact loss.
Ancestry audits find no task revision on main before final human merge and prove the accepted candidate tree on main before delivery.
key_interfaces: M1–M4 ship-rule report and UB-1..UB-11 fixture matrix
